title: Universal Local Preview
name: github-veluno-llc-veluno-universal-local-preview
description: Starts local PHP previews and safely edits literal PHP markup visually in Phoenix Code.
author: VELUNO LLC (https://github.com/VELUNO-LLC)

scripts.test: node --check main.js && node --check path-utils.js && node --check node/index.js && node --check node/runtime-manager.js && node --check node/visual-edit.js && node --test test/*.test.js
scripts.package:release: rm -f dist/extension.zip && zip -r -q dist/extension.zip package.json main.js path-utils.js styles.css node README.md LICENSE -x '*.DS_Store'
